That beyond the kind of very, very minimal set of needs orientated around our kind of bare human survival. Um, YOU know, is autonomy something that should be part of our kind of very basic understanding of what needs are for everyone, or are they associated from more critical perspectives with a kind of distinctly liberal conception of the good life? And so we get these kinds of disagreements, and so, kind of responding to this, this idea that we need this kind of wider conception of what needs are, but that we enter these controversies. speaker: George Boss

speaker: Ricardo Lopes

Whereas my reading of Marx focuses much more on his kind of on the ground political activity and his political activism. speaker: Ricardo Lopes

speaker: George Boss

speaker: Ricardo Lopes
